title: Record a host's real hook payloads with DD_CAPTURE_PAYLOADS, not from documentation
body: To learn what a harness really sends a hook, set DD_CAPTURE_PAYLOADS=<file> in the environment the hooks run with (hooks/run.cjs appends every command and payload as one JSON line), trigger the tool call, read the file, then unset it. Do not trust a documentation summary for a payload's shape, and do not register new events from the agent in .claude/settings.local.json: auto mode refuses that edit as self-modification, so an event not yet registered needs the user or a --plugin-dir session. Why: on 2026-09-24 a capture contradicted a docs-derived summary of Claude Code's payloads (the outcomes memory holds the recorded shapes); adding PostToolUseFailure to settings.local.json was denied by the permission classifier.
not_derivable: run.cjs shows the variable; that documentation summaries were wrong and that the permission classifier refuses settings edits is recorded nowhere else.

evidence.summary: DD_CAPTURE_PAYLOADS appends every command and payload.
The comment records the shapes captured this way.
